svg.text: Authentication protection and the existing predictions table
No declared foreign keys for the authentication tables
account_session_epochs.system_id is an application-managed account reference. The other supporting tables store recovery tokens, session revocations and login-throttling
This legacy table is included because it exists in the physical schema. The current forecasting route returns a demonstration forecast and does not insert that response into predictions.
Table existence is not evidence of stored or validated forecasts.

Coverage: 14 tables, 123 columns and 12 declared foreign keys from local MySQL metadata checked on 19 October 2026. Reference boxes repeat tables from page 1. This is not an independent verification of Azure’s current schema.
Passwords use bcrypt hashing. No patient rows, passwords, tokens or other database contents are included.
Local schema verified 19 October 2026. Metadata only; no patient records included.
